meta.name: caveman-commit
meta.description: Ultra-compressed commit message generator. Cuts noise from commit messages while preserving intent and reasoning. Conventional Commits format. Subject ≤50 chars, body only when "why" isn't obvious. Use when user says "write a commit", "commit message", "generate commit", "/commit", or invokes /caveman-commit. Auto-triggers when staging changes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把暂存变更压缩成简洁的提交信息
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次写提交信息都要纠结很久
copy.tagline_en: Compress staged changes into concise commit messages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you struggle to write clear commit messages

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会生成极简的 Git 提交信息，采用 Conventional Commits 格式，主题行不超过 50 字符，仅在必要时添加正文。
howto.when: 当你说“write a commit”、“commit message”、“generate commit”、“/commit”或“/caveman-commit”时触发；检测到暂存区有变更时自动触发。

say.note: Claude 会根据暂存区变更生成提交信息。

say.text: 生成一个关于修复登录 bug 的提交。
say.note: Claude 会生成类型为 fix 的提交信息。

say.text: 停止 caveman-commit，恢复详细模式。
say.note: Claude 会恢复为冗长的提交风格。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude generates ultra-compressed Git commit messages in Conventional Commits format, with subject ≤50 chars and body only when necessary.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "write a commit", "commit message", "generate commit", "/commit", or "/caveman-commit"; auto-triggers when staging changes are detected.

say_en.text: Write a commit message for me.
say_en.note: Claude generates a commit message based on staged changes.

say_en.text: Generate a commit for fixing the login bug.
say_en.note: Claude generates a commit with type fix.

say_en.text: Stop caveman-commit, revert to verbose mode.
say_en.note: Claude reverts to verbose commit style.
